name: Haus Cäcilia
beschreibung: Haus Cäcilia is located in the municipality of Tirol above Meran. It houses several holiday apartments. The individual apartments have a kitchen or kitchenette, a bathroom and a living/sleeping area. The accommodations offer a view of the Meraner Land and the surrounding mountain scenery. The center of Dorf Tirol is within walking distance. Number
